article.title: MAGI-2旗艦版公布30秒聲畫生成，開源仍列後續計劃
article.title_en: MAGI-2 flagship announces 30-second audio-video generation; open source remains planned
article.summary: Sand.ai公布480B參數MAGI-2旗艦版，公司稱可生成最長30秒的1080p同步聲畫，並支援多媒體參照。
article.summary_en: Sand.ai announced the 480B-parameter MAGI-2 flagship, describing up to 30 seconds of 1080p audio-video generation with multimedia references.
highlights: 每秒25格，原生請求最多20項參照，並有時間線及局部編輯控制。
這次是旗艦版，與114B預覽版不同；開源權重及完整報告尚在計劃。
highlights_en: The stated limit is 25 fps and 20 references per native request, with timeline and targeted-edit controls.
This is the flagship rather than the 114B preview; open weights and a full report remain planned.
article.why: 聲畫與時間線控制接在同一生成流程後，創意團隊可先檢查短片的品牌參照及剪接節奏，再決定哪些鏡頭適合生成。
article.why_en: Combined audio-video and timeline controls let creative teams assess brand references and pacing before selecting shots for generation.
article.next_step: 取得接入後，用一份30秒分鏡指定參照素材、對白及剪接點，逐項記錄人物、產品與聲畫是否一致。
article.next_step_en: After obtaining access, specify references, dialogue and cuts for a 30-second storyboard and inspect character, product and audio continuity.
article.detail: 本篇依Sand.ai研究公告報道功能，沒有進行產品實測。參數數量是模型規模，不能代替對品牌文字、產品細節及鏡頭連續性的檢查。公司亦承認高速動作可能出現軌跡或連續性瑕疵。編輯建議把易出錯的動作與品牌元素列為驗收項目，並分清已公布能力、實際帳戶接入與尚待開源的權重，避免沿用預覽版資訊推定全部可用。
article.detail_en: Capabilities follow Sand.ai's research announcement, not our product trial. Parameter count does not establish accurate logos, product details or shot continuity. The company acknowledges possible artifacts in extreme high-speed motion. Define acceptance checks around motion and brand elements, distinguishing described capabilities, account access and future open weights.
